subject: Request: bespoke onboarding package + one-time credit for Synthetix pilot
messages:
From: Rachel Greene <rachel.greene@synthetix.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging & onboarding credit for Synthetix pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We have an internal pilot approval but need a tailored packaging proposal before procurement will sign an SOW. Two asks from procurement: a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration costs, and a shorter-term reduced rate for the first 6 months while we ramp.

High-level: 6-month pilot (VPC + dedicated pool) expected to average ~250k inference tokens/day, onboarding assistance and 2 migration days from Redwood infra eng. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide:
- $75k one-time onboarding credit applied against first invoice
- 25% discount on hosted per-token rates for first 6 months
- VPC + dedicated capacity packaging (standard SLA)

Can we structure this as a limited exception if we include an explicit ramp & success criteria? I can share a draft SOW (attached) and schedule a quick alignment call if it helps. Procurement needs an internal approval path (VP/CFO sign-off) for exceptions.

Attached: Synthetix_SOW_v1.pdf

Cheers,
Rachel
Rachel Greene
Head of Procurement, Synthetix Labs
procurement@synthetix.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Greene <rachel.greene@synthetix.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging & onboarding credit for Synthetix pilot

Rachel — thanks, received. Appreciate the clear asks.

Quick replies:
- We can do a one-time onboarding credit; I need to take an internal exception request for $75k to finance.
- A 25% time-limited discount for first 6 months is feasible as a promotional pilot rate, subject to a minimum commitment and ramp milestones.
- VPC + dedicated pool packaging is supported; we will include a 30-day review and rollback clause.

I will put together an internal brief for VP/CFO sign-off and loop in Finance & GTM. Can you confirm the intended start date (first invoice month) and the minimum commitment you can sign to in the SOW? That will help the approval case.

I’ll aim to get the exception packet to you within 48 hours so procurement has a path for signature.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Attach: Synthetix_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Exception request for Synthetix pilot — $75k onboarding credit + 6mo promotional rate
Cc: 

Team — flagging a near-term pilot (Synthetix Labs) that needs a formal exception packet for VP/CFO approval. External asked for a one-time onboarding credit and a 6-month promotional discount. Summary below and attached the internal brief.

External ask
- One-time onboarding credit: $75,000 (applied to first invoice)
- Promotional discount: 25% off standard per-token rates for first 6 months
- Packaging: VPC + dedicated capacity; Redwood will provide 2 migration-days of eng support

Commercial anchor (why we should approve)
- Estimated ARR if pilot converts: $1.2M annualized (projected 12-month runrate post-pilot, conservative)
- Strategic value: Synthetix is embedded in a major HealthTech partner; referenceable in North America + potential Marketplace listing
- Time-to-value: conversion expected within 90 days of start if agreed ramp milestones met

Risk mitigation / guardrails proposed
- Discount window limited to first 6 billing cycles only
- Onboarding credit applied to first invoice; non-refundable if customer cancels after conversion period? (recommend applied as credit only on conversion)
- Mandatory ramp milestones in SOW: 30/60/90 day usage thresholds; if thresholds missed, discount is rescinded
- Finance to require deal_id SYNT-2027-0843 and a minimum 12-month post-pilot commit to qualify

Requested approvals
- Marissa: CFO-level sign-off for $75k onboarding concession
- Kimberly: Finance endorsement on construct / accounting treatment
- Karthik: Sales endorsement + recommended minimum commitment

Attachments: internal-exception-brief.pdf (contains cost/volume model and suggested legal language).

Please advise if you need additional modeling tonight; procurement is asking for an answer before their internal Friday review.

—Olga
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Exception request for Synthetix pilot — $75k onboarding credit + 6mo promotional rate

Thanks for the packet, Olga. Quick thoughts after a skim of the brief: I support making Synthetix a reference customer in healthcare — this moves the strategic needle. A few asks before I sign off with CFO authority:

1) Make the onboarding credit contingent on conversion to a paid plan (credit applies only when invoice is generated post-conversion).
2) Define the minimum 12-month commit explicitly (e.g., $100k/mo minimum committed spend or a 12-month ARR commitment equivalent).
3) Add an auto-recapture clause: if usage is below the 30/60/90 thresholds, the remaining credit is forfeited (or clawed back pro rata).

If the brief is updated with the above and Finance confirms the accounting treatment, I will approve this from the commercial authority perspective (CFO sign-off).

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance (acting CFO signatory)
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Exception request for Synthetix pilot — $75k onboarding credit + 6mo promotional rate

Olga / team — reviewed the model in internal-exception-brief.pdf. Accounting / revenue recognition note: the onboarding credit should be recorded as a contra-revenue credit and amortized against recognized revenue over the committed period once conversion is executed. Clawback language should be explicit.

We are okay with the construct provided Marissa's conditions are captured in updated SOW language and the customer signs the minimum 12-month commitment (deal_id SYNT-2027-0843).

Please update the brief to include: explicit commit definition, credit application timing, and the clawback recapture formula. Once updated I endorse and Marissa can apply CFO sign-off.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attach: internal-exception-brief.pdf (annotated)
